queries_run: Intel customer concentration risk 10-K Dell HP Lenovo percent of net revenue 2025
Dell OR HP OR Lenovo credit rating downgrade OR guidance cut 2026

findings.claim: INTC 三大客戶合計占 2025 淨營收 43%（2024 為 45%、2023 為 40%）；預期少數客戶仍將占大宗。
findings.excerpt: Collectively, our three largest customers accounted for 43% of our net revenue in 2025, 45% of our net revenue in 2024 and 40% of our net revenue in 2023.

findings.claim: 三大客戶應收帳款占比 47%（2025-12-27 與 2024-12-28），公司認為不構成重大信用風險。
findings.excerpt: We believe the net accounts receivable balances from our three largest customers (47% as of December 27, 2025 and December 28, 2024) do not represent a significant credit risk, based on cash flow forecasts, balance sheet analysis and past collection experience.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 主要客戶（Dell/HP/Lenovo 等 OEM）2026 年搜尋未見信用評等下調；僅見賣方股票評等調降（如 Barclays 2026-10 調降 Dell），非信用事件，未列入 finding。
